# Commands

Inspect the window with `herdr-app ls` and `herdr-app status`.
`herdr-app commands` lists the app actions below, even without an open window.

Run an action in the open window with `herdr-app do`:

```sh
herdr-app do pane.split --direction right
herdr-app do pane.split '{"direction":"right"}'
```

Arguments can be named flags or one JSON object. Required arguments are marked below.
Actions use the current selection unless you give an explicit target.
Some actions close terminals; read their descriptions before running them.
Mods can add their own actions, which are not listed here.

## `space.new`

Make a space: its name (default: none, so it's called after where its first terminal is), the folder its terminals start in (default: the focused terminal's), its first tab's name (default: none, so it's called by its number), optionally an agent (argv) and its first message (task), and the machine it lives on (`hc machine ls`; default this one; its terminals start in that machine's home unless folder).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `name` | no |
| `folder` | no |
| `tab` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `task` | no |
| `machine` | no |

## `space.close`

Close a space and end its terminals (asks first unless confirmed).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `confirmed` | no |

## `space.rename`

Rename a space (asks the person when no name; an empty name: called after where its first terminal is again).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `name` | no |

## `space.move`

Move a space to a position (1 = first).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | yes |
| `index` | yes |

## `tab.new`

Make a tab in a space (default: the selected one; name default: none, so it's called by its number) with a terminal in folder (default: the focused terminal's), optionally an agent (argv) and its first message (task); or with a mod as its only pane (`mod`, its `props`: a file, a board).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `name` | no |
| `space` | no |
| `folder` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `task` | no |
| `mod` | no |
| `props` | no |

## `tab.close`

Close a tab and end its terminals.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `confirmed` | no |

## `tab.rename`

Rename a tab (asks the person when no name; an empty name: called by its number again).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |
| `name` | no |

## `tab.move`

Move a tab to a position in its space (1 = first).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | yes |
| `index` | yes |

## `pane.split`

Split a pane (default: the focused one) "right" or "down" with a new terminal, or with a mod (`mod`, its `props`) beside it.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `direction` | yes |
| `pane` | no |
| `argv` | no |
| `mod` | no |
| `props` | no |

## `pane.close`

Close a pane and end its terminal.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | no |

## `terminal.open`

Start a terminal: as a new tab (place "tab", default), or "right"/"down" of the focused pane.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `argv` | no |
| `folder` | no |
| `place` | no |
| `name` | no |

## `terminal.keep`

Give a running terminal without a pane (a sub-agent) a pane: a new tab, or "right"/"down".

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |
| `place` | no |

## `terminal.park`

Take a terminal's pane away and disable core keep; it keeps running (a sub-agent shows under its parent again).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `terminal.right_click`

Where right-clicks in a terminal (default: the focused one) go when its program takes the mouse: "program" or "menu" (Herdr's, the default). Shift+right-click is always the menu.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `to` | yes |
| `terminal` | no |

## `terminal.kill`

End a terminal and its sub-agents.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `terminal` | yes |

## `browser.open`

Open a web page (http, https or about:blank) in a browser pane (macOS builds with the browser feature) with one browser tab: "right" (default) or "down" of a pane (default: the focused one), or as a new "tab" in its space. No url: the pane opens with an empty browser tab. Says its browser id and pane.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `url` | no |
| `place` | no |
| `pane` | no |

## `browser.tab.new`

Open a browser tab after the shown one in a browser pane (default: the focused browser) and show it. No url: an empty tab, waiting for an address. Says the browser's tabs.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | no |
| `url` | no |

## `browser.tab.select`

Show a browser's tab by number (index, 0 is the first; default browser: the focused one). A tab that was never shown loads its page now. A number alone (browser.tab.select:1) is the index.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `index` | yes |
| `browser` | no |

## `browser.tab.close`

Close a browser's tab (index, 0 is the first; default: the shown tab) of a browser (default: the focused one). The tab to its right is shown next, else the one to its left. Closing the last tab leaves one empty tab; the pane stays.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | no |
| `index` | no |

## `browser.navigate`

Show another page in a browser (an id from `herdr-app ls`).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | yes |
| `url` | yes |

## `browser.back`

Go back a page in a browser.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | yes |

## `browser.forward`

Go forward a page in a browser.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | yes |

## `browser.reload`

Reload a browser's page.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | yes |

## `browser.close`

Close a browser and its pane.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | yes |

## `browser.agent_browser_setup`

Add Herdr's provider to agent-browser's user config (~/.agent-browser/config.json), so a terminal that started before this Herdr can drive a browser pane with: agent-browser -p herdr --session herdr-$HC_TERMINAL_ID. Other plugins and settings in the file are kept.

No arguments.

## `browser.open_external`

Open a browser's page (default: the focused browser) in the default web browser: the page's own address, http or https only. For sign-ins Herdr's browser can't do, such as passkeys.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | no |

## `browser.devtools`

Open or close a browser's web inspector (no open: toggle): Chromium's DevTools window.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | yes |
| `open` | no |

## `browser.zoom`

Zoom a browser's page (default: the focused browser): step "in" or "out" along Chromium's steps (25% to 500%), "reset" to 100%, or level, a percent from 25 to 500. Chromium keeps one zoom per host name (all its ports) in the profile, saved across restarts, so other pages on that host follow. A number alone (browser.zoom:125) is a level. Says the zoom now, in percent.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `step` | no |
| `browser` | no |
| `level` | no |

## `browser.viewport`

Lay a browser's page out at another screen size (default: the focused browser): preset "phone" (390x844), "tablet" (820x1180), both mobile with touch, or "fit" (the pane's own size again); or width and height in pixels, with mobile true or false. A size bigger than the pane is shrunk to fit it.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `preset` | no |
| `browser` | no |
| `width` | no |
| `height` | no |
| `mobile` | no |

## `browser.screenshot`

Save a PNG of a browser's shown page as it looks (default: the focused browser) to path (absolute or ~/…; default ~/Downloads/<host>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.png). Says the path. An empty tab has no page: it refuses.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `browser` | no |
| `path` | no |

## `browser.clear_data`

Sign out of everywhere in Herdr's browser: delete every cookie of its profile, clear the HTTP cache and the site storage (local storage, IndexedDB, caches) of every site open in a tab, then reload the open tabs. Says how many cookies it deleted. The Browser menu's "Clear browsing data" asks first; this does not.

No arguments.

## `tab.settle`

Put a tab away on this screen (default: the shown one): out of the lists, still running. It comes back when shown or when an agent in it needs you.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |

## `tab.unsettle`

Bring a settled tab back to the lists.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `id` | no |

## `tab.next`

Show the next tab.

No arguments.

## `tab.prev`

Show the previous tab.

No arguments.

## `pane.zoom`

|---|---|
| `pane` | no |

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|
| `pane` | no |

## `pane.go`

|---|---|

## `pane.equalize`

Give the panes of the current tab equal widths and heights.

No arguments.

## `pane.swap`

Swap the focused pane with its neighbor in a direction.

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|

## `pane.resize`

Move the focused pane's divider a step (5%) "left", "right", "up" or "down".

|---|---|

| `pane` | no |

## `pane.resize_mode`

Resize panes with h/j/k/l or the arrows until Esc, Enter or r; other keys do nothing meanwhile.

No arguments.

## `terminal.peek`

Peek at a running terminal over the tab, with keep-as-tab and close controls.

|---|---|

## `terminal.show`

Show a terminal in a pane for now, in place of its own (no terminal: back).

| Argument | Required |
|---|---|

## `terminal.copy`

Copy the focused terminal's selection.

No arguments.

## `terminal.paste`

Paste into the focused terminal (copied files as if dropped; an image alone as terminal.paste_image pastes it).

No arguments.

## `terminal.paste_image`

Ctrl+V: the clipboard's image as a file on the focused terminal's machine, when that's another one; on Windows, paste clipboard text; otherwise Ctrl+V goes to the terminal.

No arguments.
